WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    WHERE ((t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric > 5.0 
           AND t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive')
       OR (t.voldaily / t.acctbal > 0.5)
),
high_freq_high_risk AS (
    SELECT hrt.tradereg
    FROM high_risk_traders hrt
    JOIN trader t ON hrt.tradereg = t.tradereg
    WHERE t.freqscope = 'High'
),
significant_enforcement AS (
    SELECT ea.*
    FROM enforcementactions ea
    WHERE ea.penimp IN ('Fine', 'Ban')
       OR ea.acttake = 'Suspension'
       OR ea.busrestr = 'Full'
),
financially_impactful AS (
    SELECT se.*, t.acctbal
    FROM significant_enforcement se
    JOIN compliancecase cc ON se.compref2 = cc.compreg
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.traderef
    WHERE se.penamt / t.acctbal > 0.1
)
SELECT fi.enforcereg, fi.traderestr
FROM financially_impactful fi
JOIN high_freq_high_risk hfhr ON fi.traderef = hfhr.tradereg;
